task.question: Whose goal in the Argentina vs Cape Verde Round of 32 match was voted the best goal of the tournament?
task.evidence: Eleven minutes later, Sidny Lopes Cabral found the ball in the Argentinian half. Entering from the left side of the penalty area, he curled right-footed past the goalkeeper and into the top right corner of the net to make it 2–2. This was later voted the best goal of the tournament.
